title: Method of monitoring and trigger-locking a firearm
abstract: A method of monitoring and trigger-locking a firearm prevents unauthorized persons from firing the firearm. When a person picks up the firearm, a biometric scanner retrieves an unidentified biometric reading off of the person. The biometric scanner can be a palm-print reader and/or a fingerprint reader. If the unidentified biometric reading does not match an authorized user signature stored on a chipset of the firearm, and if the firearm has unlocked its trigger, then the firearm automatically locks its trigger. In addition, the firearm generates and broadcasts an unauthorized-use notification with a wireless communication module. If the unidentified biometric reading does match an authorized user signature stored on the chipset, and if the firearm has locked its trigger, then firearm automatically unlocks its trigger. The firearm also collects situational data from environmental sensors when the firearm discharges a round.

title: Intelligent weapon
abstract: A system for monitoring use of a weapon. The system includes a monitoring station and at least one weapon in which the weapon fires a projectile. The weapon includes a tracking device, in which the tracking device receives navigational data, and a transceiver. The transceiver transmits at least the navigational data to the monitoring station. The weapon can further include a biometric identifier for identifying a user and a trigger mechanism in which the biometric identifier can enable the trigger mechanism only when the biometric identifier identifies an authorized user. In one arrangement, the tracking device can be a global positioning system receiver that can receive navigational data from a plurality of global positioning system satellites.

title: Firearm Safety Assembly
abstract: A firearm safety assembly for preventing the firearm from being discharged by an unauthorized user includes a processor coupled to a firearm. A fingerprint scanner is coupled to the firearm. The fingerprint scanner may read an authorized user's fingerprint. The fingerprint scanner is operationally coupled to the processor. A thumbprint scanner is coupled to the firearm. The thumbprint scanner may read the authorized user's thumbprint. The thumbprint scanner is operationally coupled to the processor. A trigger lock is coupled to the firearm. The trigger lock is operationally coupled to the processor. The trigger lock allows the firearm to be fired when the processor receives the authorized user's fingerprint and thumbprint. A GPS is coupled to the firearm. The GPS is operationally coupled to the processor. The GPS determining a location of the firearm.

title: Personalized intelligent identification police-used gun management device and system
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a personalized intelligent identification police-used gun management device and system. The device comprises a single chip microcomputer, a lock body unit, anintelligent identification unit, a positioning unit, a communication unit and a power supply unit, wherein the single chip microcomputer is arranged in a gun and connected with the other five units, the lock body unit comprises a trigger lock and a gun sleeve lock, the intelligent identification unit adopts fingerprint identification, the positioning unit adopts a GPS unit, and the communication unit comprises a Bluetooth unit and a GPRS unit; and the intelligent identification unit collects user fingerprints and compares the user fingerprints with fingerprint data typed in the single chip microcomputer in advance, the single chip microcomputer controls opening and closing of the trigger lock according to a comparison result, the gun geographic position information transmitted by the GPS unit through the GPRS unit can be inquired on a mobile terminal in real time, and the power supply unit supplies power to a gun-end power supply through wireless charging. According to the personalizedintelligent identification police-used gun management device and system, personalization of a police-used gun can be achieved, the gun is locked as soon as the gun is separated from the hand, an opponent can not use the gun after the gun is snatched, and the gun can be found through a real-time positioning function after being lost.

title: Bullet cabinet intelligent alarm system
abstract: The invention discloses a bullet cabinet intelligent alarm system. The system comprises an electronic gun lock, a fingerprint identification apparatus and a camera, wherein the electronic gun lock, the fingerprint identification apparatus and a cipher lock are electrically connected with a signal server, the signal server is electrically connected with a processor, the processor is electrically connected with an alarm, the processor is in bidirectional electrical connection with a monitoring center, and the camera is respectively connected electrically with the monitoring center and a memory. According to the invention, unlocking signal monitoring is carried out on the electronic gun lock, the fingerprint identification apparatus and the cipher lock through the signal server, once an abnormal unlocking situation is monitored, signals are immediately transmitted to the processor, the processor controls the alarm to give an alarm, at the same time, the processor transmits the signals to the monitoring center, and the monitoring center, after receiving alarm signals, immediately sends out correlation personnel to figure out the situation. Compared to a conventional bullet cabinet alarm system, the bullet cabinet intelligent alarm system responds more timely and rapidly, and can better facilitate management of a bullet cabinet.

title: Gun safe
abstract: The invention provides a gun safe. The gun safe comprises a processor module, a communication module, an alcohol detecting module, a fingerprint identification module, a display module, a touch control module, a safe door module, a gun lock module and a power module. The processor module is connected with all the other modules and controls all the other modules to work. The communication module is used for conducting data communication with an external server. The alcohol detecting module is used for detecting the alcohol concentrations in the bodies of the personnel getting firearms and ammunition. The fingerprint identification module is used for identifying the identities of the personnel. The display module is used for displaying an operation interface, the work condition of a safe body and an operation result. The touch control module is used for human-machine interaction. The safe door module is used for controlling a safe door of the gun safe to be opened and detecting the state of the safe door. The gun lock module is used for controlling a gun lock to be opened and detecting the open state of the gun lock. The power module is used for supplying power to the whole system. The gun safe is beneficial for the improvement of work efficiency and the reduction of cost and improves the use safety of the firearms and ammunition.

title: Gun and bullet getting and returning and vein self-service authentication management system
abstract: The invention relates to a gun and bullet getting and returning and vein self-service authentication management system. The system is characterized by comprising a computer arranged in a gun cabinet, wherein the computer is connected with a palm vein acquisition instrument; the computer is further connected with a database server through a network line; the computer is further connected with a cabinet door control board of the gun cabinet, a cartridge clip lock and a gun lock through serial ports; and when personnel are authenticated, palm vein information is read through the palm vein acquisition instrument and sent to the database server to perform identity comparison, a cabinet door opening command is sent through a serial port when the identity is legal, a gun cabinet door is opened, and the corresponding cartridge clip lock and gun lock are opened. The system has the beneficial effects of simple structure, convenient use, high accuracy and strict management; and automatic control and vein authentication technologies are adopted, so that the problems of slow getting and returning, low authentication efficiency and the like of existing bullets are solved and the efficiency of gun and bullet getting and returning process and personnel identity authentication is improved.

title: Biometric firearm trigger lock with alarm
abstract: This disclosure provides a trigger lock system that includes a trigger lock that collects a fingerprint and unlocks when the fingerprint matches a stored fingerprint. The trigger lock in-cludes a wireless communication module, for example, Bluetooth module and a Thread module, such that it can connect to a user device by Bluetooth or internet through a Thread router. The trigger lock may be unlocked remotely by sending a command from the user device. The trigger lock may send information of each attempt to unlock the trigger lock by fingerprint to the user device. The trigger lock may send alerts to the user device. The trigger lock also includes an alarm that produces alert when unauthorized personnel attempts to unlock the trigger lock.

title: Digital fingerprint gun cabinet
abstract: The utility model discloses a digital fingerprint gun cabinet which comprises a vertical equipment cabinet, and an embedded field management computer, a gun cabinet controller, a hard disk video and a power supply, which are arranged on the vertical equipment cabinet. title: Gun trigger unlocked through biological fingerprint identification
abstract: The invention discloses a gun trigger unlocked through biological fingerprint identification. The gun trigger comprises a gun trigger shell body, a gun trigger shell cover and a machine shell; a control board is mounted at the top in the gun trigger shell body through screws; a fingerprint identifying module is mounted at the top of the control plate through a limiting groove; a fingerprint setting key is mounted on one side of the bottom end of the control plate through screws; the machine shell is arranged at the bottom end of the control plate; a motor is mounted in the machine shell through a mounting base; a rotating wheel is arranged on an output shaft of the motor through a fixing piece; an elliptic limiting plate is mounted at the bottom of the machine shell through bolts; an L-shaped rack lock tongue capable of sliding is arranged in the elliptic limiting plate; the gun trigger shell cover is mounted at the bottom of the gun trigger shell body through bolts; and a return spring is connected to the top of the gun trigger shell cover through a limiting clamping groove. The gun trigger unlocked through biological fingerprint identification is simple in structure, convenient to produce, high in unlocking efficiency, high in practicability and suitable for wide popularization and application.

title: Weapon with safety system
abstract: Weapon with a security system, characterized in that it comprises an identification device for the user carrying the weapon, connected to a control module that controls a trigger locking system (2) of the weapon, configured to unlock the weapon if the user is correctly identified, or to block the trigger (2) if the user is not correctly identified, where the user identification device comprises a fingerprint reader (1) and the locking system is formed by a pin moved by a motor, configured so that the pin (3) is inserted through a through hole (4) made in the trigger (2) blocking its movement, the motor being powered by a battery.

title: Biological fingerprint identification unlocking gun trigger
abstract: The utility model discloses a trigger for unlocking a gun through biological fingerprint identification. The gun trigger comprises a gun trigger shell, a gun trigger shell cover and a machine shell. Acontrol panel is mounted at the top in the gun trigger shell through screws; a fingerprint identification module is mounted at the top of the control panel through a limiting groove; a fingerprint setting key is mounted on one side of the bottom end of the control panel through a screw; a machine shell is arranged at the bottom end of the control panel. A motor is installed in the machine shell through an installation base. An output shaft of the motor is provided with a rotating wheel through a fixing piece; an oval limiting plate is installed at the bottom of the machine shell through bolts, a slidable L-shaped rack spring bolt is arranged in the oval limiting plate, a gun trigger shell cover is installed at the bottom of the gun trigger shell through bolts, and a reset spring is connected to the top of the gun trigger shell cover through a limiting clamping groove. title: Fingerprint recognition safety systems
abstract: A universal fingerprint recognition system for firearms that greatly reduces misuse and accidental discharge of a firearm. The fingerprint recognition assembly is completely embedded within the firearm to prevent tampering. A chip embedded in the trigger scans the firearm owner's fingerprint, and when recognized releases a safety pin, allowing the trigger to be pulled. A charging port embedded in the firearm's grip allows a USB-type connector to be attached and charge the battery chip in the CPU.

title: Three-level networking bullet dynamic management system
abstract: The invention discloses a three-level networking bullet dynamic management system which comprises a fingerprint recognition device, an electronic tag and a timing module. The fingerprint recognition device and a human face scanning device are electrically connected with a digitalized bullet cabinet and a data storage device, the timing module is electrically connected with an electronic gun lock and a management monitoring center, the management monitoring center is connected with the digitalized bullet cabinet and a city-level monitoring center through broadband, and the city-level monitoring center is connected with a province-level monitoring center through broadband. The bullet cabinet is opened in a verification mode through the fingerprint recognition device and the human face scanning device and cannot be opened unless correct verification is achieved, the electronic gun lock cannot be opened unless a unique RFID code on the electronic tag on a gun is scanned and input, the digitalized bullet cabinet transmits all information of gun taking to the management monitoring center through the broadband, three-level supervision is achieved due to three-level networking of the province-level monitoring center, the city-level monitoring center and the management monitoring center, and safety and normalization are greatly improved.

title: Firearm with fingerprint recognition and electronic-control percussion function
abstract: The invention discloses a firearm with fingerprint recognition and electronic-control percussion functions. The firearm has the advantages that a fingerprint recognition device is arranged on the front surface of a trigger of the firearm, bullets can be percussed under electronic control of the firearm, fingerprints of a firearm holder are read by the fingerprint recognition device on the front surface of the trigger when the firearm holder pulls the trigger, a control circuit can be connected with an electronic-control coil if the firearm holder is authorized to use the firearm, accordingly, the bullets can be impacted by a firing pin of an armature and can be discharged under the electronic control of the firearm, and problems of unauthorized use of existing firearms and accidental discharge of the existing firearms can be solved.

title: Pistol anti-robbery protection device
abstract: A handgun tamper-evident device comprising an integral sensing fingerprint identification device electrically linking more than one locking device to form a protective device mounted on a barrel, a waistband, or a gun strap, the locking device of which may be provided at one end of the barrel and the buckle strap, or at a corresponding gun bow within the barrel, or at a waistband buckle, or at a strap buckle, The body sensing fingerprint identification device is mounted on the surface of the barrel, or at the waistband buckle, or at the strap buckle, and is unlocked by pressing the first power source for activation, and then the fingerprint identification mechanism is activated to identify the person who is correct by simultaneously firing a lock at the bow and a lock at one end of the buckle, thereby removing the gun from service immediately, not only safely controlling the use of the gun branch, but also effectively preventing the use of the gun branch.

title: Intelligent trigger lock
abstract: An intelligent trigger lock employs biometric authentication for securely locking a firearm by blocking access to a trigger. The intelligent trigger lock includes: a housing formed to the contours of the firearm; a cavity within the housing configured to receive the trigger; a locking pin inserted through the housing; a contact point; electronic circuitry operable to release the locking pin upon receiving biometric authentication; and a power source.

title: Gun trigger lock
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of gun trigger locks, in particular to a gun trigger lock, in a locking state, a user uses fingerprints set in a fingerprint module on a circuit board by himself to unlock the lock, in the locking state, a supporting rod of a cam faces downwards and is not in contact with a spring bolt piece, and in the locking state, the supporting rod of the cam is not in contact with the spring bolt piece. The lock tongue head of the lock tongue piece extends into the lock hook side clamping groove of the lock hook piece, so that the lock hook piece cannot be pulled out, connection of the upper shell and the lower shell of the lock is achieved, a locked object located between the upper shell and the lower shell cannot be separated out, and the locking function is achieved. In the unlocking state, after fingerprint recognition succeeds, the motor is started, the cam is driven to rotate, the first matching inclined face on the cam abuts against the second matching inclined face on the vertical push plate, the spring bolt piece is driven to be away from the lock hook side clamping groove, the spring bolt is made to be separated from the lock hook side clamping groove, separation of the upper shell and the lower shell is achieved, and the gun trigger lock is opened.

title: Intelligent gun lock
abstract: The utility model discloses an intelligent gun lock. Gun lock comprising a gun lock body, the gun lock body is provided with an intelligent controller, a fingerprint recognition device, a storage device, a data interface, a mechanical lock, an alarm, a power supply, a control key and an indicator lamp. A locking groove is formed in one side of the gun lock main body; a gun lock automatic driving lock hook matched with the mechanical lock is mounted in the locking groove; a circular placement groove is formed in the inner wall of one side, far away from the opening, of the locking groove; a fixing shaft is welded to the inner wall of the side, away from the opening, of the circular containing groove, a clamping groove is formed in the side, close to the opening, of the fixing shaft, clamping bases elastically hinged to the fixing shaft are arranged on the four sides of the clamping groove, the four clamping bases are jointly fixed to the same clamping block, and the clamping block and the clamping groove are movably installed. The locking device is economical and practical, and the sensor is simple to disassemble in the locking groove, so that the sensor is convenient to replace.

title: Biometric gun lock
abstract: A gun lock device and firearm security system configured to prevent unauthorized use of a firearm. The gun lock device includes a lower housing, an upper housing, and a locking mechanism comprising a motor and a latch pin. The latch pin is actuated by the motor to engage or disengage a catch pin, thereby locking or unlocking the device. A control circuit, powered by an internal power source, controls the motor based on external signals, which may be received wirelessly. The system further includes a mobile device that captures biometric data, such as a fingerprint, and communicates with the control circuit to authorize unlocking of the gun lock. A cable is connected to the gun lock device to provide additional physical security. Tamper detection sensors and an audible alert system can also be integrated to enhance security and provide feedback upon unlocking attempts.

The CPU of the Gun System executes software with data from the memory to identify authorized users with stand-alone electrical device; to discharge Unauthorized user with remote power switch or systems; to prohibit firearm use in restricted areas such as schools and other public places with GPS device and disable the gun trigger by moving it into the locked position with disabling device. title: Weapon trigger interlock and monitoring system
abstract: A firearm activation and monitoring system which tracks, monitors, and automatically prevents a firearm from firing when a user is not in a suitable state of mind or is not an authorized user, as well as a method for activating and monitoring a firearm. The firearm activation and monitoring system generally comprises a firearm having a trigger and grip area, a plurality of biometric sensors located on the grip area which measure biometric data of a user, a trigger interlock, and a main microcontroller. The trigger interlock prevents the trigger from firing the firearm when the trigger interlock is in its normal or default position. To unlock the trigger, the user holds the grip area to activate the biometric sensors, and if the user is in an acceptable mental state, the main microcontroller will send an electrical signal to the trigger interlock, which unlocks the trigger and allows the user to pull the trigger of the firearm.

title: Fingerprint collection device for access control and personal weapons and other systems controlled thereby
abstract: The numerical aperture (NA) of the optical fiber is reduced to allow the cross-lighting phenomenon of the optical fiber prism assembly to be tolerated so as not to exceed 0.5 if possible. A substantial portion of the light travels along the optical fiber based on a fine image, such as a fingerprint, at an input end of the assembly. At the assembly output, a detector responds to the electrical signal arrangement based on the surface undulations. These signals are processed to check the identity of fingerprints or the like, as well as used to control access to personal weapons, other equipment, facilities, data, or money services. As much as possible, the assembly uses a separation element such as, for example, an optical fiber taper (through which the input light does not cross) that is high NA due to out-of-area absorption of the EMA material. In the case of weapons, an anti-oversight module (which matches the weapon port and must also be cosmetically embodied) holds a portion of the access control and firing system. Bullets and the like are fired only when a specific signal is generated from the module.

abstract: TRIGGER LOCK SYSTEM WITH DIGITAL FIRE ENGINE SENSOR. The information will be analyzed by a microcontroller (3) who will decide whether or not the person is allowed to fire. The decision will be sent to a microtrigger (4) which, if the user is authorized, will release the trigger (6). If the user squeezes it, the user will be displaced necessary to displace the trigger rod, with the dog disarming and triggering the projectile. If the user is not allowed to use, the trigger (6) will not be released.

title: Electronic gun lock bracket and unlocking and locking method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an electronic gun lock bracket and an unlocking and locking method thereof. A transverse pillar of a gun lock is provided with a U-shaped groove. The U-shaped groove is provided with an electronic lock. A base is provided with a gun barrel orifice groove corresponding to the U-shaped groove. A first distance sensor and a second distance sensor are arranged in the gun barrel orifice groove and the U-shaped groove separately. A warning device is arranged in the middle of the front face of a first stand column. A gun lock control device is arranged in the middle of the front face of a second stand column. A password authentication touchpad is connected outside the gun lock control device. The electronic lock, the warning device, the first distance sensor and the second distance sensor are all electrically connected with the gun lock control device. By means of the electronic gun lock bracket and the unlocking and locking method thereof, due to arrangement of the first distance sensor and the second distance sensor, the electronic lock can be closed automatically after a gun is sensed, the take-away time of the gun is kept, and control over the gun is enhanced; and unlocking is achieved through password or fingerprint verification, the warning device can give out an alarm when passwords or fingerprints are input three times and are incorrect, and relevant personnel can be reminded to check the condition.

abstract: The invention provides a gun inspection room system based on face recognition and voiceprint recognition. title: Internet of things based position tracking intergration weapon management system
abstract: A location tracking type integrated weapon management system based on internet of things includes: at least one field arsenal which stores weapons such as firearms or magazines; a field manager terminal which stores information related to an approval of carry-out of weapons in a DB; and a remote responsible person terminal which receives, stores, and monitors the related information stored by the field manager terminal. The related information includes identification information of carry-out of a weapon and weapon information; information related to the weapon is read and transmitted by a reader by attaching an NFC tag for recognition to the weapon; an identification process is performed by a face recognition device about a person who returns the carry-out of the weapon; and situations of carry-in and carry-out of the weapon are recorded by attaching a camera capable of photographing an area around the field arsenal. The field manager terminal enables an approval process after identification by receiving identification information by the face recognition device; a GPS module is mounted in the weapon; the real-time location of carry-out of the weapon is grasped by displaying the location information of carry-out of the weapon through the GPS module on a GIS map; a wired/wireless service is possible in all positions capable of internet by building a clouding system connected to an integrated management server between the field manager terminal and the remote responsible person terminal; and a system can be expanded without stopping a service.

title: Firearm system and method thereof
abstract: This invention relates to a firearm system using biometric fingerprint recognition technology to ensure exclusive operation by authorized individuals. title: Portable intelligent gun box device

title: Firearm safety system
abstract: A firearm safety system restricts the use of the firearm by reference to biometric data received by a sensor (23) coupled to the firearm trigger (26). The biometric data is compared to at least one record of biometric data associated with a permitted user to determine whether firearm actuation is permitted. Firearm actuation is controlled by an anchor (24) that is pivotally coupled to the firearm trigger (26). Firearm actuation is prevented when the anchor is extended between the trigger (26) and the trigger aperture (21). title: Techniques for dynamically managing a gun component
abstract: The present disclosure provides systems and techniques for dynamically operating a peripheral component of a gun, such as a flashlight, an electronic sight, or a haptic motor. The gun may perform an authentication procedure to identify a user operating the gun, retrieve a configuration file from memory housed in the gun in response to the authentication procedure, and perform a function at the peripheral component based on the configuration file indicating that the function is to be performed for the user. The gun may collect authentication data, such as biometric data or token data, and the gun may identify the user operating the gun based on the authentication data. The user operating the gun may be identified in response to matching the collected authentication data to authentication data stored in the memory, and the gun may determine the function based on the configuration file indicating the function for the user.

title: System and method for monitoring and securing a military weapon
abstract: A system (100) for monitoring and securing a military weapon is disclosed. A biometric sensing chip (102) senses fingerprint of a user. A biometric recognition module (110) receives user recognition data representative of sensed fingerprint of the user, matches the user recognition data with historical user recognition data, identifies authentication of the user using a neural network accelerator. An access control module (120) enables access to the user for using the military weapon. A data monitoring and securing module (130) tracks user handling data representative of usage of the military weapon by the user in real-time, encrypts the user handling data for security purpose using a physical unclonable function based key generation technique. An actuation module (140) determines pressure of a finger of the user when the access for using the military weapon is obtained, sends activation signal for triggering of the military weapon by based on the pressure determined.

abstract: The utility model relates to the field of creating a special sniper rifle for conducting targeted operations against enemy terrorist groups near our border and within the country, and also is capable of engaging low-flying air targets (helicopters, UAVs), external equipment of enemy tanks and armored personnel carriers, snipers and is a weapon of small airborne units, long-range infantry reconnaissance groups, etc. In the 75 years since the end of the Second World War, many different models of sniper rifles have been created in the world. title: Lightweight trigger mechanism-based instant threat early warning and active traceability deterrence method and system in power system network
abstract: The invention discloses an instant threat early warning and active traceability deterrence method and system based on a lightweight trigger mechanism in a power system network, and relates to the field of power system network security. According to the method, a light load trip line is preset at a key node, a suspicious attack log is generated in combination with a hidden Markov model, and multi-channel instant early warning is triggered; extracting multi-dimensional fingerprints of a browser, hardware and a special network weapon to construct a warehouse, and generating three types of flight fragments of deep acquisition, remote control and vulnerability repair for precise delivery; and performing confusion packing processing on the control software, and realizing active traceability deterrence in a matching/non-matching mode. According to the invention, threat identification accuracy and response speed are improved, an active defense closed loop is formed, and the method is suitable for security protection of a power system network.

title: Firearm authentication and tracking system
abstract: A system and method for managing one or more firearms having an authentication device is described. The method may receive a profile of one or more firearm users. The profile of the one or more firearm users may be registered to access one or more authentication devices coupled to one or more firearms. A usage of the one or more firearms coupled to the authentication devices may be tracked via the profile of the firearm user. title: Electronic lock system of firearms trigger
abstract: The Electronic Lock System of Firearms Trigger receives a long-distance command (remote control), via radio control, to lock the trigger of the weapon, verifies the database if this command is valid and sent by management team and, if so, keeps the trigger locked or locks it, and does not allow unauthorized people make use of the weapon. The Electronic Locking System of Firearms Trigger consists of a transceiver - transmitter / receiver (2), which will receive the command from long- distance lock. The received information will be analyzed by a microcontroller (3) that it will give the permission to make shots. The decision will be sent to a microdrive (4) that, if the user has authorization, or if there is no order of locked, release the trigger (6). If the user has been unauthorized remotely by management team, the trigger (6) will not be released. If the trigger (6) already released and a locked command is sent during use, a decision will be sent from the microcontroller (3) to the microdrive (4), that it will lock the trigger (6) and prevent the user from making new shots.

title: Firearm with User Identification System
abstract: A firearm system includes a firearm and a user identification system built-in with the firearm. The user identification system includes a locking module that releasably locks up a trigger-actuated firing mechanism of the firearm from being actuated, a camera module being activated for generating tangible evidence of operation incidents, and an activation module operatively linked to the locking module. The activation module pre-stores authorized user data and continuously collects user operation data not only to activate the camera module for capturing image but also to actuate the locking module to unlock the trigger-actuated firing mechanism when the authorized user data is matched with the user operation data. Once the authorized user data is not match with the user operation data, the trigger-actuated firing mechanism is instantaneously locked to prevent an unauthorized usage of the firearm.

title: Magazine based, firearm safety apparatus for modifying existing firearms employing a digital, close proximity communications system and a low power electro-permanent magnet interlock system
abstract: A magazine-based firearm interlock that can be added to a commercial firearm, with a release/locking device on the firing mechanisms enabled by an electro-permanent magnet, control electronics in the removable magazine, and authorized through a wearable authorization device. Modifications are applied to the trigger bar or sear mechanism which enables it to be changed to an unlocked state, which allows a shot to be fired, and to a locked state, which prevents a shot from being fired. A communication system includes a chip set in the firearm magazine that communicates with a FOB carried by the user, which authenticates the user and activates the electro-permanent magnet to enable the firearm to fire. This system is preferably a near field communication system that couples to and transmits across the body of the user. Indicators can be included to indicate the operational state of the interlock and to detect and record discharges.

title: Safety control device for fire guns
abstract: The invention discloses a safety control device for fire guns. A battery module, a motion sensing module, a remote communication module, an identity verifying module and an electronic unlocking moduleof the safety control device for the fire guns are separately connected to a controller mutually; the input end of a lock body is connected to the output end of the electronic unlocking module; the motion sensing module is used for obtaining a motion state of the controller, and outputting a motion state signal to the controller; the controller outputs the motion state signal, and outputs a firstcontrol signal for controlling on/off of the remote communication module; the remote communication module receives an authorized signal of a remote server, and outputs a first unlocking signal to thecontroller; the identify verifying module receives a biological identifying signal of a fire gun user to verify, and outputs a second unlocking signal to the controller after verification is passed;and the electronic unlocking module is used for controlling opening of the lock body according to the first unlocking signal and/or the second unlocking signal. The scheme improves use safety of the gun fires of a gun fire unit.

title: Geolocation-reporting weapon-tracking device
abstract: Provided is a method that includes determining a device geolocation based on a satellite signal received by a weapon-tracking device and receiving a sensor reading using a sensor attached to the weapon-tracking device, wherein the sensor is sensitive to a use of the weapon. The instructions include determining that a change in the sensor reading satisfies a change threshold and, in response to a determination that the change threshold is satisfied, transmitting device state data to a wireless signal receiver via a wireless signal, wherein the device state data comprises a device identifier and the device geolocation. The instructions further include storing the device identifier and the device geolocation in a data server in communication with the wireless signal receiver and transmitting a message based on the device identifier and device geolocation to a client from the data server.

title: Target range management system
abstract: A target range management system disclosed by the present invention comprises an identity collector used for collecting the identity information of a shooting user at a target position; an identity verification server which is used for being in communication connection with the identity collector, obtaining the identity information sent by the identity collector and verifying the identity information; and a target range weapon control server which is used for being connected with the identity verification server and unlocking a weapon for the target position when the identity information passes the verification. title: Systems and methods for preventing friendly fire through infrared recognition and authentication
abstract: Systems and methods prevent friendly fire using infrared object recognition. An IR projector projects a beam of IR radiation at a first wavelength onto the object and an IR detector, having a field of view of the object, detects IR fluorescence from the object, where a wavelength of the fluorescence is a function of the first wavelength. The system includes a memory for storing software having machine readable instructions that, when executed by a processor, perform the steps of: (a) controlling the IR projector to generate IR at the first wavelength; (b) controlling the IR detector to capture the object fluorescence; and (c) identifying the object as friendly or non-friendly based upon the object fluorescence. The system further includes an inhibitor for preventing firing of a gun or missile when the object is identified as friendly.

title: System and method for protecting items stored in a cargo area of a vehicle
abstract: The present disclosure provides a system and method for protecting items stored in a cargo area of a vehicle. The present disclosure generally relates to systems and methods for securing items in a vehicle. An exemplary method may include a processor receiving a primary trigger to unlock a door of the vehicle, and then unlocking the door to allow access to a cargo hold. An auxiliary trigger for unlocking a safety lock that is part of a cargo item holder located in the cargo hold may then be received. The processor may perform an authentication procedure on the secondary trigger and unlock the security lock based on successful authentication of the secondary trigger. In an exemplary embodiment, the cargo item holder is a gun rack including a safety lock, the primary trigger may be a signal generated by activating a button switch, and the secondary trigger may be a verbal command, a signal generated by a smart tag, or an image of an individual.

title: Security devices and methods for regulating access to items secured within
abstract: Security holsters and methods for securing a firearm are provided. In one example, the security holster includes: a body including a cavity for receiving the firearm; a locking mechanism extending at least partially into the cavity for selectively securing at least a portion of the firearm within the cavity; an access authentication assembly configured to receive/provide authentication data for determining if a requesting user requesting access to the firearm is an authorized user; a device condition sensor configured to provide device condition data associated with at least one of the security holster and an environment in proximity to the security holster; and a computing device operably coupled to the locking mechanism, the access authentication assembly, and the device condition sensor, and configured to regulate the security holster between a locked configuration where access to the firearm is denied and an unlocked configuration where the firearm is accessible.

title: Electronic arms security system and method for securing a firearm
abstract: The invention relates to an arms security system, comprising a first touch-sensitive user interface for receiving user data characterising a user. This first touch-sensitive user interface is located in a contact area of an arm that is touched by the user in order to shoot. The arms security system also has a control device comprising an input unit for receiving user data, a computer unit for checking user data and an output unit. If the user data check is successful, indicating that the user is authorised to use the arm, the output unit emits a release signal in order to release the trigger mechanism of the arm. The arms security system comprises a user terminal for providing the touch-sensitive user interface with the user data, said terminal having the user data and a body transmission device which is connected to the user for transmitting user data to the first touch-sensitive user interface when the latter is touched.

title: A firearm having an intelligent controller
abstract: A firearm having a programmable electronic control (28) for firing electrically ignitable ammunition (17) has a user authorization apparatus (34) and the capability to receive inputs from a plurality of sensors including a magazine presence sensor, a Round-In-Chamber sensor, grip sensors, and a battery status sensor. The electronic control (28) of the present invention has a programmable microcontroller (30), a power supply system using batteries (24), an ignition system that converts low level voltage from the batteries (24) to the required voltage to fire the electrically ignitable ammunition (17), a user authorization apparatus, and an options interface adaptable to receive inputs from system sensors. The firearm of the present invention is programmed to enable firing only if safe and authorized firing conditions are determined. title: Electromechanical sear and methods of operating a gun using the same
abstract: The present disclosure provides systems and techniques for an electromechanical sear that is implementable in a gun. The gun may include a fire control manager, and the fire control manager may identify a trigger break based on a trigger sensor, transmit, based on the trigger break, a first signal to a first actuator located in a displacement path of a sear, so as to cause the first actuator to be displaced in a first direction, and transmit, based on the trigger break, a second signal to a second actuator located in the displacement path of the sear, so as to cause the second actuator to be displaced in a second direction. The transmitting the first signal to the first actuator and the transmitting the second signal to the second actuator may cause displacement of the sear and firing of the gun.

title: Method and apparatus for secure issuance of secure firearm identification credentials
abstract: The invention brings together the components of digital image capture and digital fingerprint capture to both speed up and make more secure the process of applying for a firearm permit and the process of issuing a firearm permit. Biometric data captured, such as face and finger, is used in both verifying the applicant's asserted identity (biometric verification) and in ensuring the applicant is not a member of a group (or database) of individuals who should not be granted a permit (biometric identification). Furthermore, the invention discusses issuing a credential that is inherently more secure than printed and laminated credentials that are ubiquitous today. The invention simultaneously improves service to residents via reduced credential issuance timelines, improves the security of who is issued a firearm credential, and improves the integrity of the firearm credential.

abstract: The utility model discloses an intelligent gun security lock which comprises a left lock seat and a right lock seat which are interlocked. The left lock seat and the right lock seat can be fixed and clamped to the position of a trigger of a gun after being interlocked. The right lock seat comprises a lock rack and a lock seat shell. The lock seat shell is provided with a fingerprint collection board. The lock rack and the lock seat shell are fixedly connected into a whole, and a containing cavity is formed inside the space formed after the lock rack and the lock seat shell are connected into a whole. A locking mechanism, an intelligent fingerprint processing module and a motor are installed in the containing cavity. The left lock seat is provided with a spring bolt which can extend into the containing cavity of the right lock seat and is matched with the locking mechanism in a locking mode. The fingerprint collection board, the intelligent fingerprint processing module and the motor are in electrical signal connection. The intelligent gun security lock is unlocked in a fingerprint identification mode, the safety performance is higher, locking and unlocking can be achieved rapidly, operation is easy and convenient, and use is more reliable.

title: Electronic scale with face recognition function
abstract: The invention discloses an electronic scale with a face recognition function, and relates to the field of electronic scales with face recognition functions. The system comprises an electronic canning pile and a weighing platform, a liquid crystal operation screen and an NFC card reader are fixedly installed at the top of the front end of the electronic canning pile, a face recognition instrument is fixedly installed at the top end of the electronic canning pile, a filling gun is installed at the front end of the electronic canning pile, and a control switch is fixedly installed at the side end of the electronic canning pile. abstract: The invention discloses a smart safety lock for guns. The smart safety lock comprises a left lock seat and a right lock seat which are locked with each other. title: Automobile charging pistol locking device and control method thereof
abstract: The invention provides an automobile charging pistol locking device and a control method thereof. The control method comprises the steps that a fingerprint recognition module collects user fingerprint information and verifies whether the collected fingerprint is legal or not; when the collected fingerprint passes verification, an electronic lock control module arousing command and a charging control module arousing command are sent to arouse an electronic lock control module and a charging control module correspondingly; the charging control module generates a charging state command according to the charging state of an automobile after being aroused and sends the charging state command to the electronic lock control module; and the electronic lock control module judges whether an electronic lock needs to be unlocked or not according to the charging state command. According to the automobile charging pistol locking device and the control method thereof, the identity of a driver is verified through the fingerprint recognition module, a charging pistol is unlocked when the fingerprint passes verification and charging is stopped, and the charging pistol is locked in the charging process, so that the situation that as the charging pistol is pulled out by accident or stolen, charging is interrupted by accident and consequently inconvenience is caused to users is avoided.

title: Gun receiving monitoring system and monitoring method
abstract: The invention designs a gun receiving monitoring system and a monitoring method, and aims to realize comprehensive monitoring, management and control of a gun receiving process for competitive sports. title: Man-machine interaction auxiliary method and system for operating underwater weapon equipment
abstract: The application discloses a man-machine interaction auxiliary method and a system for operating underwater weapon equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting electromyographic signals, holding pressure signals and torque feedback signals to generate multichannel operation signal streams; the method comprises the steps of extracting a characteristic vector, determining an operation intention type, generating an operation node sequence, monitoring position deviation quantity, generating a guiding force instruction, controlling a force feedback device to generate tangential traction force or normal vibration force, collecting heart rate variability signals and galvanic skin response signals, evaluating cognitive load grades, dynamically adjusting guiding force amplitude and time window, switching an emergency braking mode when abnormal working conditions are detected, and calling an emergency operation path. The system comprises a physiological signal acquisition module, an intention recognition module, a force feedback guiding module, a state self-adaption module, a parameter learning module and an emergency safety module. According to the application, the operation behavior is directly guided through force feedback, and the reliability and safety of the operation of the underwater weapon equipment are improved by combining the cognitive load dynamic adjustment and personalized learning.

title: Secure smartphone-operated gun trigger lock
abstract: A battery-powered trigger-locking device, which is configured to be disposed on a gun with a trigger for firing, includes a data receiver, a data memory and a logic device for determining whether data received by the receiver is the same, or substantially the same, as data stored in the memory. If a data match is indicated, the logic device causes an electromagnetic device to move a trigger-locking member to an unlocked position, permitting the gun to be fired. A separate electronic gun key is provided to transmit gun unlock data to the data receiver of the trigger-locking device. This gun unlock data may be a password, a long pseudo-random number or biologic data identifying the gun owner or some other person who is licensed or otherwise authorized to fire the gun.

title: Fire hydrant water pressure testing device
abstract: The utility model provides a fire hydrant water pressure testing device, which relates to the field of fire hydrant water pressure testing and comprises a water pressure testing gun, the surface of the water pressure testing gun is communicated with an adjusting unit, the adjusting unit is used for adjusting the flow of fire fighting water in an inner cavity of the water pressure testing gun, and a testing unit is arranged on the surface of the water pressure testing gun. The testing unit is used for detecting the flow and pressure of fire fighting water, the left end of the surface of the water pressure testing gun is communicated with a pressure release valve, the pressure release valve is used for sealing and releasing pressure of an inner cavity of the water pressure testing gun, and the adjusting unit further comprises a shell; according to the utility model, through the arrangement of the adjusting unit, the effect of adjusting the flow and the pressure of fire-fighting water during testing is achieved, and the flow requirement required by actual fire extinguishing can be simulated through controlling the flow of the fire-fighting water, so that the performance of a fire hydrant system can be verified, and the use effect of the water pressure testing device is effectively improved.

title: Integrated firearm information system
abstract: System and method for collecting, storing, and providing information related to firearms. More specifically, an embodiment tracks ownership and/or possession of a firearm from its manufacture onward (i.e., from cradle to grave) between and among registered firearm manufactures, firearm sellers/dealers, individual gun owners, pawn shops, law enforcement agencies, government agencies, and any other entity or individual stakeholder that may own and/or posses the firearm. An embodiment may further authenticate firearm-related transactions, provide notifications to registered users, and enable local and global reports of loss, theft, and/or the use in a crime.

title: RFID-based electric gun program pushing method and device
abstract: The invention relates to an electronic gun program pushing method and device based on RFID, and belongs to the technical field of automobile manufacturing. The electric gun program pushing method comprises the following steps: when a to-be-assembled vehicle body enters an assembly section, obtaining a vehicle body unique identifier in RFID information and section information of the assembly section, and obtaining a plurality of target electric gun programs according to the vehicle body unique identifier and the section information, pushing each target electric gun program to an electric gun controller of a corresponding station on an assembly section according to the assembly type, and generating and storing first feedback data after a worker on the station operates an electric gun to execute a tightening program; the electric gun program is pushed to the electric gun controller of the station in the assembly section through the unique identifier of the vehicle body, so that the time required for setting and adjusting the electric gun by a worker is shortened, and an effective prompt is provided for the worker through feedback data of the electric gun; and feedback data of the electric gun is stored in a feedback database, so that data support can be provided for follow-up problem tracing.

title: Firearms management system
abstract: A device, system, and associated methods for the management of firearms for locating, tracking, monitoring, indentifying discharge, and related management tasks are disclosed. In one embodiment, a firearm is disclosed having a processor adapted for storing information and receiving and acting upon command and a location monitor adapted to provide specific geographic location information. The processor and location monitor can be integrally formed in a single electronic device. The firearm also includes a connectivity port and a connectivity cable. The system can also include a monitoring station and a configuration computer. In at least one embodiment, a firearm utilizes a processor and a GPS monitor for locating, tracking, monitoring, indentifying discharge, and related management tasks.

title: Method for controlling firearm safety based on Internet of things and smart firearm
abstract: An embodiment of the invention discloses a method for controlling firearm safety based on Internet of things (IOT) and a smart firearm. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring position information at a present moment by the smart firearm; acquiring biological feature information of a user by a biological feature acquisition module arranged on a surface of the smart firearm after determining that the smart firearm is located in an authorized region according to the position information; and unlocking the smart firearm when determining that the biological feature information is matched with preset biological feature information. In the embodiment of the invention, after the smart firearm is located in the authorized region, the user can unlock the smart firearm by inputting fingerprint information, a use range of the smart firearm can be limited and the authorized users can be allowed to use the smart firearm. In addition, after the smart firearm leaves the authorized region,the alarm can be given timely and the position information of the smart firearm can be reported in real time.

title: Intelligent gun and ammunition cabinet
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent gun and ammunition cabinet which comprises a cabinet body, a master control system and a safety detection module. The cabinet body comprises an electric control cabinet door, an operation panel, an electric control gun lock and an electric ammunition drawer. The cabinet door is used for closing the cabinet body and can be opened through electric control under right operation. The operation panel is used for mounting a fingerprint identification module, a video monitoring module and a touch display module. The electric control gun lock is used for fixing and locking guns. The electric control ammunition drawer is used for storing ammunition. According to the intelligent gun and ammunition cabinet, various of alarm sources can be detected without other equipment while the guns and the ammunition are stored, taken and managed through a vibration sensor, a temperature sensor, a humidity sensor and a water soaking sensor, a dehumidifier is mounted in the cabinet and conducts intelligent dehumidification operation when the humidity in the cabinet is larger than a set value under the condition of no artificial interference, and therefore labor and equipment input reduction and work efficiency improvement are facilitated, the cabinet is suitable for safe use management of the guns and the ammunition, the safety of the gun and ammunition cabinet is enhanced, and the intelligent degree of the gun and ammunition cabinet is increased.
